title: Declared event RateUpdated is never emitted
rootCause: Event `RateUpdated(uint256 newRate, uint256 newBalance)` declared but never emitted. `rewardPerSecond` is recomputed in `_updatePool`, `collectReward`, and `setDepletionDuration` — all natural emission sites.
impactSummary: Off-chain rate monitoring is incomplete; combined with DEDUP-001 (rate re-anchored on every interaction), no event trail records the actual rate trajectory.
preservedDetails: CODE-012 carries the analysis and ties to DEDUP-021 (observability gap).
remediation: Remove the unused event OR emit from `_updatePool`'s rate-change branch and from `setDepletionDuration`.
dedupNotes: Adjacent to DEDUP-021 (ECON-010) which is the broader observability story.
